description: Public-safe product-surface registry for the MMIR frontend. Status labels describe whether a surface is offered, not live health telemetry. Live health and model availability come from api.mmir.ai or a paired local node.

providers.label: Supergeni Hosted Free
providers.route: MMIR frontend -> api.mmir.ai -> policy-approved free routes
providers.notes: Available now. Provider credentials stay server-side; hidden candidates and paid routes remain excluded until their control gates pass.

providers.label: Local Connector
providers.route: MMIR frontend -> paired local connector -> local model runtime
providers.notes: Optional local-first path. The UI must only call a paired connector and must not expose a raw model-runtime port.

providers.label: Compatible Backend
providers.route: MMIR frontend -> user-selected compatible backend API
providers.notes: For users who bring a trusted compatible backend. Secrets and provider credentials must remain outside the public page.

providers.label: Managed Provider Routing
providers.route: MMIR frontend -> api.mmir.ai -> protected provider router
providers.notes: Not a live public product surface. Activation requires explicit cost, secret, receipt, rollback and owner-approval gates.
